Title: Virtual Network Integration Support (Public Preview) for Azure Stream Analytics

Body.Content: ASA is thrilled to announce public preview of Virtual Network Integration support for Azure Stream Analytics!  Get the benefits of a dedicated cluster, without paying for it!  Lock down access and take advantage of private endpoints, service endpoints, and rip the benefits of full network isolation by deploying a containerized instance of your Azure Stream Analytics job in your virtual network.  This capability is only available in select regions.  Learn about enabling VNET integration in your region here.
